* feat(portal): support configurable OIDC username claim for user identity

Apollo used the OIDC/JWT subject (sub) as the Apollo user identity
(Users.Username). Enterprise IdPs often carry an opaque UUID in sub and
the real login name in another claim such as preferred_username.

Add spring.security.oidc.user-id-claim-name (default: token subject) and
resolve the user id through a shared OidcUserInfoUtil helper so both the
authentication success listener and the user info holder agree. When the
configured claim is missing or blank, fall back to the subject so a user
is never created with an empty id. Non-breaking: unset keeps sub behavior.

Closes #5633

* docs: add CHANGES entry for configurable OIDC username claim (#5655)

* test: add class-level Javadoc to OidcUserInfoUtilTest

* test: migrate OidcUserInfoUtilTest to JUnit 5 (Jupiter)

* fix(portal): fail closed on missing OIDC id claim, document identity security contract

Address review on #5655:
- Reject login (BadCredentialsException) when a configured user-id claim is
  missing or blank, instead of falling back to sub, so the same principal is
  not provisioned as two accounts across the OIDC and JWT paths.
- Document the claim security contract (IdP-controlled, unique, immutable,
  non-reassignable, non-user-editable), the 64-char Username limit, and the
  conditional recommendation for preferred_username, in the EN and ZH guides.
- Add cross-path and blank-JWT-claim test coverage.
- Move the CHANGES entry to the bottom of the 3.0.0 section.

* test: add JWT blank-claim rejection case for configurable OIDC username claim (#5655)
